verdict.rationale: Pulumi is open source and documents a DIY state backend that stores state in object storage you manage (S3, Azure Blob, GCS), so you aren't locked into Pulumi Cloud. Infrastructure definitions are ordinary code in general-purpose languages, and the Cloud REST API exposes state and history, which together support leaving. However, the evidence never documents an explicit export of all Pulumi Cloud data (state, history, ESC secrets/config, policies) or names the open formats such an export would use. Missing for 10: documented full-account data export (e.g., stack state export/migration between backends), explicit open-format specification for exported state and history, coverage of ESC/secrets and Cloud metadata export, independent hands-on corroboration of a clean exit.
